question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

My sister wants everybody to **always do what she tells them to do**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"dance to the tunes"** means to always **do what someone tells you to do, often without question**__. (किसी के अनुसार चलना)

 __
 
• **Example: **John always **dances to the tunes** of his boss, never questioning any orders.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Till the cows come home **(बहुत लंबे समय तक): Refers to something that will take a very long time or forever.

 
 
• **Example:** He can talk about cricket till the cows come home.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Hands are tied **(हाथ बंधे होना): Means being unable to act due to some restrictions or limitations.
 
 
• **Example: **I would love to help you, but my hands are tied due to the company policy.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Make it big** (बड़ी सफलता पाना): Means to achieve great success.
 
 
• **Example:** She moved to the city hoping to make it big in the fashion industry.
 
 

39:Tb94,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
